ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) central core covering approximately 65-70% of surface area, contrasted with high-intensity (white/light grey) lateral margins and tips occupying approximately 30-35%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation forms a broad wedge from the insertion point to the notch. High-intensity white pigmentation is concentrated on the distal regions of both lobes, featuring irregular speckled transition zones along the interior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 130 degrees; depth is minimal relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, with amplitudes ranging from 3-8 pixels at current resolution. The central trailing edge near the notch is relatively smoother.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a distinct concave curve from the median notch extending upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) are visible across the dark central pigmentation, including a prominent curved mark on the upper left lobe and multiple diagonal scratches in the center-right region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated curved white scar is visible on the inner-upper quadrant of the left lobe's dark pigmentation. Significant irregular scarring and possible barnacle colonization on the terminal edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white border along the trailing edge of the far right tip, contrasting sharply with the adjacent dark pigmentation.
